audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim election, herem, covenant loyalty, and conquest exhortation, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for seven nations, total-destruction and no-covenant commands, intermarriage rationale, sacred-site destruction, treasured-people election, covenant love, fertility/health blessings, gradual conquest, and idol-metal prohibition.

verses.restored: When YHWH your Divine brings you into land where you are entering to possess it and clears away many nations from before you—Hittite, Girgashite, Amorite, Canaanite, Perizzite, Hivite, and Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than you—

familiar.text: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

modern.text: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—

original.text: כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶל הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְנָשַׁ֣ל גּֽוֹיִם רַבִּ֣ים מִפָּנֶ֡יךָ הַֽחִתִּי֩ וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֨י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֜י וְהַכְּנַעֲנִ֣י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֗י וְהַֽחִוִּי֙ וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י שִׁבְעָ֣ה גוֹיִ֔ם רַבִּ֥ים וַעֲצוּמִ֖ים מִמֶּֽךָּ

verses.restored: and YHWH your Divine gives them before you and you strike them, you shall surely devote them to destruction; you shall cut no covenant with them and show them no favor.

familiar.text: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

modern.text: and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.

original.text: וּנְתָנָ֞ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ וְהִכִּיתָ֑ם הַחֲרֵ֤ם תַּחֲרִים֙ אֹתָ֔ם לֹא תִכְרֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם בְּרִ֖ית וְלֹ֥א תְחָנֵּֽם

verses.restored: You shall not intermarry with them; your daughter you shall not give to his son, and his daughter you shall not take for your son.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

modern.text: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,

original.text: וְלֹ֥א תִתְחַתֵּ֖ן בָּ֑ם בִּתְּךָ֙ לֹא תִתֵּ֣ן לִבְנ֔וֹ וּבִתּ֖וֹ לֹא תִקַּ֥ח לִבְנֶֽךָ

verses.restored: For he will turn your child from after me, and they will serve other gods; anger of YHWH will burn against you and destroy you quickly.

familiar.text: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

modern.text: because they will turn your sons away from following Me to serve other gods. Then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.

original.text: כִּֽי יָסִ֤יר אֶת בִּנְךָ֙ מֵֽאַחֲרַ֔י וְעָבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְחָרָ֤ה אַף יְהוָה֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ֖ מַהֵֽר

verses.restored: But thus you shall do to them: tear down their altars, smash their pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their carved images with fire.

familiar.text: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

modern.text: Instead, this is what you are to do to them: tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.

original.text: כִּֽי אִם כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּ֙ לָהֶ֔ם מִזְבְּחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם תִּתֹּ֔צוּ וּמַצֵּבֹתָ֖ם תְּשַׁבֵּ֑רוּ וַאֲשֵֽׁירֵהֶם֙ תְּגַדֵּע֔וּן וּפְסִילֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרְפ֥וּן בָּאֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: For a holy people are you to YHWH your Divine. YHWH your Divine chose you to be for him a treasured people from all peoples upon face of ground.

familiar.text: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

modern.text: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.

original.text: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה

verses.restored: Not because you were more numerous than all peoples did YHWH delight in you and choose you, for you were the fewest of all peoples,

familiar.text: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

modern.text: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

original.text: לֹ֣א מֵֽרֻבְּכֶ֞ם מִכָּל הָֽעַמִּ֗ים חָשַׁ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם וַיִּבְחַ֣ר בָּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי אַתֶּ֥ם הַמְעַ֖ט מִכָּל הָעַמִּֽים

verses.restored: but because YHWH loved you and kept oath he swore to your fathers, YHWH brought you out with strong hand and redeemed you from house of slaves, from hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

familiar.text: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

modern.text: But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

original.text: כִּי֩ מֵֽאַהֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה אֶתְכֶ֗ם וּמִשָּׁמְר֤וּ אֶת הַשְּׁבֻעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּע֙ לַאֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם הוֹצִ֧יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֑ה וַֽיִּפְדְּךָ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים מִיַּ֖ד פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Know that YHWH your Divine, he is Divine, faithful Divine, keeping covenant and covenant loyalty to a thousand generations with those loving him and keeping his commands,

familiar.text: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

modern.text: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.

original.text: וְיָ֣דַעְתָּ֔ כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאֵל֙ הַֽנֶּאֱמָ֔ן שֹׁמֵ֧ר הַבְּרִ֣ית וְהַחֶ֗סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֛יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מצותו לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר

verses.restored: and repaying to face one who hates him, to destroy him; he will not delay toward one who hates him; to his face he will repay him.

familiar.text: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

modern.text: But those who hate Him He repays to their faces with destruction; He will not hesitate to repay to his face the one who hates Him.

original.text: וּמְשַׁלֵּ֧ם לְשֹׂנְאָ֛יו אֶל פָּנָ֖יו לְהַאֲבִיד֑וֹ לֹ֤א יְאַחֵר֙ לְשֹׂ֣נְא֔וֹ אֶל פָּנָ֖יו יְשַׁלֶּם לֽוֹ

verses.restored: You shall keep command and statutes and judgments I command you today, to do them.

familiar.text: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

modern.text: So keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances that I am giving you to follow this day. The Promises of God (Exodus 23:20–33)

original.text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֨ אֶת הַמִּצְוָ֜ה וְאֶת הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: It shall be, because you listen to these judgments and keep and do them, YHWH your Divine will keep with you covenant and covenant loyalty he swore to your fathers.

familiar.text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

modern.text: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the LORD your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.

original.text: וְהָיָ֣ה עֵ֣קֶב תִּשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֤ת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְשָׁמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אֶֽת הַבְּרִית֙ וְאֶת הַחֶ֔סֶד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you; he will bless fruit of your womb and fruit of your ground, your grain, new wine, oil, offspring of cattle and increase of flock, upon ground he swore to your fathers to give you.

familiar.text: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

modern.text: He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will bless the fruit of your womb and the produce of your land—your grain, new wine, and oil, the young of your herds and the lambs of your flocks—in the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.

original.text: וַאֲהֵ֣בְךָ֔ וּבֵרַכְךָ֖ וְהִרְבֶּ֑ךָ וּבֵרַ֣ךְ פְּרִֽי בִטְנְךָ֣ וּפְרִֽי אַ֠דְמָתֶךָ דְּגָ֨נְךָ֜ וְתִֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶ֨יךָ֙ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֔ךָ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ

verses.restored: Blessed shall you be above all peoples; there shall not be barren male or female among you or among your livestock.

familiar.text: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

modern.text: You will be blessed above all peoples; among you there will be no barren man or woman or livestock.

original.text: בָּר֥וּךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה מִכָּל הָעַמִּ֑ים לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה בְךָ֛ עָקָ֥ר וַֽעֲקָרָ֖ה וּבִבְהֶמְתֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: YHWH will turn away from you every sickness and will not place upon you any of harmful diseases of Egypt that you knew, but will put them upon all who hate you.

familiar.text: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

modern.text: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.

original.text: וְהֵסִ֧יר יְהוָ֛ה מִמְּךָ֖ כָּל חֹ֑לִי וְכָל מַדְוֵי֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם הָרָעִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֗עְתָּ לֹ֤א יְשִׂימָם֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּנְתָנָ֖ם בְּכָל שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall consume all peoples YHWH your Divine gives you; your eye shall not pity them, and you shall not serve their gods, for that would be snare to you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

modern.text: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.

original.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ אֶת כָּל הָֽעַמִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ לֹא תָחֹ֥ס עֵֽינְךָ֖ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְלֹ֤א תַעֲבֹד֙ אֶת אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי מוֹקֵ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לָֽךְ

verses.restored: If you say in your heart, These nations are more numerous than I; how can I dispossess them?

familiar.text: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

modern.text: You may say in your heart, “These nations are greater than we are; how can we drive them out?”

original.text: כִּ֤י תֹאמַר֙ בִּלְבָ֣בְךָ֔ רַבִּ֛ים הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵיכָ֥ה אוּכַ֖ל לְהוֹרִישָֽׁם

verses.restored: You shall not fear them; you shall surely remember what YHWH your Divine did to Pharaoh and all Egypt,

familiar.text: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

modern.text: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:

original.text: לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א מֵהֶ֑ם זָכֹ֣ר תִּזְכֹּ֗ר אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְפַרְעֹ֖ה וּלְכָל מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: the great trials your eyes saw, signs and wonders, strong hand and outstretched arm by which YHWH your Divine brought you out; so YHWH your Divine will do to all peoples whom you fear.

familiar.text: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

modern.text: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.

original.text: הַמַּסֹּ֨ת הַגְּדֹלֹ֜ת אֲשֶׁר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְהָאֹתֹ֤ת וְהַמֹּֽפְתִים֙ וְהַיָּ֤ד הַחֲזָקָה֙ וְהַזְּרֹ֣עַ הַנְּטוּיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצִֽאֲךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כֵּֽן יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ לְכָל הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה יָרֵ֖א מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Also hornet YHWH your Divine will send among them until those remaining and hiding from you perish.

familiar.text: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

modern.text: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.

original.text: וְגַם֙ אֶת הַצִּרְעָ֔ה יְשַׁלַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם עַד אֲבֹ֗ד הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֛ים וְהַנִּסְתָּרִ֖ים מִפָּנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall not be terrified before them, for YHWH your Divine is in your midst, a great and fearsome Divine.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

modern.text: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.

original.text: לֹ֥א תַעֲרֹ֖ץ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ בְּקִרְבֶּ֔ךָ אֵ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל וְנוֹרָֽא

verses.restored: YHWH your Divine will clear away these nations before you little by little; you will not be able to finish them quickly, lest beasts of field multiply against you.

familiar.text: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

modern.text: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.

original.text: וְנָשַׁל֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛ל מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ מְעַ֣ט מְעָ֑ט לֹ֤א תוּכַל֙ כַּלֹּתָ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר פֶּן תִּרְבֶּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה

verses.restored: YHWH your Divine will give them before you and confound them with great confusion until they are destroyed.

familiar.text: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

modern.text: But the LORD your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.

original.text: וּנְתָנָ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְהָמָם֙ מְהוּמָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽם

verses.restored: He will give their kings into your hand, and you shall cause their name to perish from under heavens; no man shall stand before you until you destroy them.

familiar.text: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

modern.text: He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand against you; you will annihilate them.

original.text: וְנָתַ֤ן מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת שְׁמָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם לֹֽא יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ בְּפָנֶ֔יךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִֽדְךָ֖ אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Carved images of their gods you shall burn with fire. You shall not covet silver and gold upon them or take it for yourself, lest you be snared by it, for it is an abomination to YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.

modern.text: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the LORD your God.

original.text: פְּסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּן בָּאֵ֑שׁ לֹֽא תַחְמֹד֩ כֶּ֨סֶף וְזָהָ֤ב עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ לָ֔ךְ פֶּ֚ן תִּוָּקֵ֣שׁ בּ֔וֹ כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ הֽוּא

verses.restored: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become devoted to destruction like it; you shall utterly detest and abhor it, for devoted to destruction it is.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

modern.text: And you must not bring any detestable thing into your house, or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. You are to utterly detest and abhor it, because it is set apart for destruction.

original.text: וְלֹא תָבִ֤יא תֽוֹעֵבָה֙ אֶל בֵּיתֶ֔ךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ חֵ֖רֶם כָּמֹ֑הוּ שַׁקֵּ֧ץ תְּשַׁקְּצֶ֛נּוּ וְתַעֵ֥ב תְּֽתַעֲבֶ֖נּוּ כִּי חֵ֥רֶם הֽוּא

translation_notes: Election is rooted in love, oath, and liberation from slavery—not numerical strength or racial superiority.
Herem/total-destruction language, no-mercy commands, and destruction of sacred sites are morally dangerous ancient conquest rhetoric and must never be enacted against modern peoples or religions.

The intermarriage prohibition is framed around religious allegiance within an ancient conquest setting; it must not authorize bans on interracial, intercultural, interfaith, or queer relationships today.
Fertility and health promises must not shame infertile, disabled, or chronically ill people or imply that illness proves covenant failure.
The command to destroy images cannot justify modern iconoclasm or desecration of another community's sacred objects.
'Chosen' and 'treasured' are Jewish covenant terms and must not be turned into Christian supersessionism or ethnic supremacy.
safety_note: Never use Deuteronomy 7 to justify genocide, ethnic cleansing, forced conversion, segregation, anti-miscegenation, religious-site destruction, infertility shame, ableism, or claims of racial superiority. Preserve election as responsibility grounded in liberation, not permission to dominate.
